Messages.Author: kushiel
Messages.Body: What's the timing on when cards such as Malkavian Rider Clause ("Only usable during a referendum before voting occurs") and Confusion of the Eye ("Only usable during a referendum before any votes are cast") may be played? Is it before or after the terms of the referendum have been set?

Messages.Author: jozxyqk
Messages.Body: As far as I've always understood it, there is no "impulse" between "Political Action is successful" and "terms of the referendum are set". Nothing can be played between those 2 events.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson (Rulemonger)
Messages.Body:
> kushiel wrote:
> What's the timing on when cards such as Malkavian Rider Clause ("Only usable during a referendum before voting occurs") and Confusion of the Eye ("Only usable during a referendum before any votes are cast") may be played? Is it before or after the terms of the referendum have been set?

> Rulebook section 6.3.2.1 wrote:
> Choose the terms, if any, of the referendum. Cards that are used "during a political action" but "before votes are cast" are used at this time (after the terms are set).

Messages.Author: kushiel
Messages.Body:
Heh. Shows how long it's been since I actually read the rulebook.

Thanks.
